items.title: Flatness of a thickening lift is equivalent to the conormal map being an isomorphism
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: Given a morphism of first order thickenings of algebraic spaces whose restriction to the closed parts is flat, the lemma shows that f' is flat with X the fibre product over the thickening exactly when the canonical map from the pullback of the conormal sheaf to the conormal sheaf of X in X' is an isomorphism. The proof compares the two square-zero extensions defining the thickenings, expresses the fibre-product condition as the vanishing of the difference of the extension classes, and relates that vanishing to bijectivity of the conormal map. Identifying flatness with the fibre-product condition and then with the conormal isomorphism is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 4002-4040.
